messages:
viv: Short RFC follow-up: propose a compact v2 pin contract to reduce ambiguity between alias and artifact. Sketch below.

morgan: Go on. What are the core fields?

viv: Keep runtime small: most inference calls use pin_ref string. Admin APIs create full pin objects. Full pin object fields: pin_value, policy (strict|prefer|legacy), provenance (algo+hash), compat_tags (namespaced short tags), origin, optional expires_at.

sanjay: Strong +1 separating alias vs artifact fingerprint. Real problem: same alias can point to different artifacts after quantization. Fingerprint stops silent drift.

oliver: For high QPS, runtime should accept pin_ref or legacy model_pin string. If pin_ref present, server resolves quickly; otherwise fallback to alias resolution.

talia: Regarding policies: strict => reject mismatch (409), prefer => attempt matching artifact else fall back and emit telemetry, legacy => current behavior. Make these explicit in docs.

morgan: Agree. Also add a compact telemetry tag pin_origin to show who set it (route, tenant, request).

sanjay: Suggest compat_tags use short namespaces: t:tok-v2, q:q4_0, k:kv-v1. Keep arrays small. Admin UIs send tags; runtime caches them.

viv: Example admin create (sent only via admin API): {pin_value: "redwood/gptx-1", policy: "prefer", provenance: "sha256:abcd...", compat_tags: ["t:tok-v2","q:q4_0"], origin: "tenant-admin", expires_at: "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z"} — note we only send provenance as single string algo:hash to keep JSON tiny.

morgan: On storage, we can expand into proto. Migration plan: backfill provenance where possible; mark remaining legacy pins with policy=legacy and notify owners.

oliver: Runtime behavior: precedence request_pin > route_pin > tenant_pin > org_pin > global. Documented and enforced. Allow tenant_force opt-in but default route wins.

sanjay: For prefer fallbacks, runtime should attach `pin_fallback_reason` to trace: e.g., "no fingerprint match; chose q fallback". That helps product explain latency/cost regressions.

talia: UI work: show small badge: alias (fingerprint?) and origin. If provenance absent, display "legacy alias" and a CTA to resolve.

bot-ci: CI: schema tests queued for branch viv/pin-v2.

viv: Action items: I will write RFC with schema examples, small migration runbook, and a compact error contract for 409. Morgan/Sanjay will prototype resolver changes. Talia will mock admin UI. If no objections by EOD I'll open the PR.

morgan: LGTM.

oliver: +1

sanjay: +1

viv: Thanks all.
